notes: τῷ … τούτῳ: the attributive demonstrative occupies the determiner slot, so the article is unrepresented under rule 38 and the case-realizing according to stays with αἰῶνι (rule 21).
τί takes the supplied is under rule 63, the subject being the noun phrase τὸ θέλημα and the interrogative the predicate; rule 53's pronoun exception is not in point.

One English the is written for τὸ θέλημα, so s019 takes it and the second attributive s023 is its own unrepresented unit under rule 23; the three reordered adjectives stay on their own Greek words under rule 2.
εἰς takes the clause-introducer that and the nominalizing article is unrepresented (rule 61); the expressed ὑμᾶς is the infinitive's subject written as ye.
